scientific_integrity: The closed index formula follows from an exactly specified 27-state cyclic transfer and its integer characteristic polynomial. Nonvanishing, eventual sign and exponential protection follow from certified algebraic root separation and finitely many exact initial values. Numerical approximation is illustrative only; independent external audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the uniform hard-core supersymmetric fermion Hamiltonian on the simple generalized Petersen graphs GP(n,3), n>=7. The Witten index lower-bounds, but does not equal in general, zero-energy multiplicity. No exact parity-resolved ground-state count, perturbed-model stability, or full spectrum is established.
title: Nonvanishing Witten indices and exponential supersymmetric zero-mode protection on step-three generalized Petersen networks
